title: Индекс для каждого внешнего ключа
verify: SELECT t.relname AS tbl, c.relname AS idx, am.amname AS method, i.indisunique AS is_unique, (SELECT string_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, n, true), ', ' ORDER BY n) FROM generate_series(1, i.indnkeyatts) n) AS key_cols FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam WHERE c.relname LIKE 'idx\_%' AND c.relnamespace = current_schema()::regnamespace ORDER BY 1, 2

negative.why: индекс не на тот столбец (по дате заказа, а не по внешнему ключу)
